title: 匯入學員資料 — Variant C Integration and E2E
content:
AF-021 整合任務：將 AF-027 Variant C mapping component 與 AF-028 stateless API 串接成 Upload → Map columns → Review → Result 流程，完成 UI state 與端到端驗證。

AF-019 先提供來源欄位 index、原始標題、資料列及列號；AF-027 owns the mapping UI component/dictionaries; AF-028 owns raw mapping validation, stateless inspect/mapped-preview/confirm APIs, and atomic User creation. AF-021 owns only the wizard page orchestration, API calls, visible loading/error/disabled states, and end-to-end screenshots.

Browser retains File and mapping state; every API stage re-uploads the file. No importId, server-side preview session, or client-trusted mapped records. Final confirm remains disabled until server validation succeeds for the complete file. The confirmed UI layout is Variant C, with a split target-field/sample-table workspace and a stacked mobile layout.

comments.name: User
comments.text: Approved design decisions: User owns canonical identity data; no server-side preview store; imports are all-or-nothing.

comments.name: User
comments.text: Approved adding flexible source-header mapping; exact unique matches may auto-map, unmatched fields are resolved by the admin. Selected Variant C on 2026-10-06.

acceptance: CSV/XLSX leading fully blank rows are skipped; first nonblank row is exposed as the source header candidate without guessing past it
Unique normalized exact matches are auto-mapped; unfamiliar and duplicate labels can be manually mapped by source index
Every required target is mapped once; a source column cannot map to multiple targets; optional targets may remain blank
Invalid mappings return clear errors and cannot be confirmed
Variant C keeps target mappings beside the source sample table and stacks both panels on mobile
After a source column is mapped to idDocNumber, its displayed sample values are masked
Preview shows first 20 rows with row-level validation errors; any invalid row blocks the entire import
Validation catches invalid email/phone, missing required fields, invalid ID data, database duplicates, and duplicates within the uploaded file
Confirm multipart request re-uploads the file; no importId or server-side preview store is used
Confirm reparses and revalidates, then creates all User records in one Prisma transaction; any DB failure rolls back all rows
User is the canonical source for ID document data; import does not create Registrant rows or overwrite existing users
Preview offers a CSV download of validation errors with source row, field, and message
Template download produces CSV + Excel with correct column headers
Admin UI has 4-step flow: Upload → Map columns → Review → Result, wired to AF-028's stateless API contract
Validation/structural errors are visible before confirm and can be exported as error details
File type validation (.csv, .xlsx only), max file size limit (10MB)
All UI labels use dict (i18n: en, zh-hk, zh-cn)
Integration test proves a failed database write leaves no rows from the batch
All changed UI copy is dictionary-driven for en, zh-hk, and zh-cn
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass

Verify inspect and mapped preview are read-only, confirm reuploads file+mapping, invalid mappings/rows cannot confirm, success creates all Users, and failure leaves no partial writes. Capture Variant C desktop/mobile and error-state screenshots; run npm run typecheck, npm run lint, and npm run build.
